Q5651.reason: An 'as is' clause generally doesn't bar claims for express misrepresentation, and the ad and website falsely stated the model year as 1964.

Q5672.reason: A justified killing is no crime at all, so the instigator has no derivative liability, whereas insanity or diminished capacity are personal excuses that don't negate the principal's act.

Q8537.reason: A value-neutral definition of punishment leaves open the question of what justifies it, so justification isn't settled in the definition itself.
